title: Sourcing report
intro: Savings from sourcing (KPI G-8) against the requests they came from, by kind of baseline and by quarter, the time from opening an RFx to approving its award, and the RFx still open. The figures come from the system, not from AI.
moduleOff: This organization has not switched on the sourcing module, so this report is not available yet.
periodInvalid: The dates chosen cannot be used (the start must not be after the end), so this quarter up to today is shown instead
noneYet: No award approved in this period yet

summary.title: Savings in this period (G-8)
summary.median: Median business days from opening the RFx to approving the award
summary.hint: Savings = baseline − awarded amount, both before VAT; negative when the award costs more than the baseline · The baseline is the quotation selected in the request, else the requester's estimate, and a reference price for an RFx raised from a need · Business days on the organization’s calendar, one decimal; with an even count, the lower middle value.
summary.withoutBaseline: {count} award(s) have no baseline (an RFx from a need without a reference price): left out of the savings, counted in the business days

quarters.title: By quarter
quarters.caption: Savings of each quarter by the award's approval date, by kind of baseline

awards.title: Awards approved in this period ({count})
awards.caption: Awards approved in this period, with their baseline, awarded amount, savings and business days
awards.emptyTitle: No award approved in this period
awards.emptyHint: Try a longer period, or see the RFx still open below.
awards.only: Showing only the awards with this baseline: {kind}.

open.title: RFx still open ({count})
open.intro: RFx open for bids, closed or being evaluated, the nearest close first, whatever the period.
open.caption: RFx still open by their close
open.emptyHint: A new RFx shows here until its award is approved or it is cancelled.

export.title: Export to Excel
export.hint: The file has the rows of the awards table, with the file's checksum.
